name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: Fixed OTA update checks failing when the GitHub API request was blocked by a CORS preflight
Added cache-busted raw version.json and package.json fallbacks so new releases are still detected when the GitHub API is unavailable
Update-check failures now show a clear error message instead of falsely reporting the app is already on the latest version
No changes to billing, backup/restore, or the current navigation workflows
